You've hit your session limit · resets 1:30am (America/New_York)

Quota resets at 2026-09-20 05:30 UTC.
github: POST /repos/thomasmeadows/HiveDispatch/pulls: 403: Resource not accessible by personal access token

The files already exist on hive/SCRUM-3 (AGENTS.md with a full lint/test/push protocol, CLAUDE.md pointing to it) and PR creation is failing with a 403 token-permission error, not a content issue — should this ticket be closed/skipped until the GitHub PAT is granted pull-request write access, rather than re-dispatched to a coding agent?

Every lint invocation is still denied by the permission policy, even with the updated permissions: `go run github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/...@latest` (denied), `golangci-lint` (not on PATH — exit 127), and the absolute path `/home/thomas/go/bin/golangci-lint` (denied; the allowlist entry `Bash(golangci-lint:*)` is prefix-matched, so an absolute path doesn't match). I've stopped trying rather than routing around the policy.

The fix on the environment side is one of:
- put `$(go env GOPATH)/bin` (`/home/thomas/go/bin`) on the worker's `PATH`, so plain `golangci-lint run ./...` — which the allowlist already permits — resolves; or
- ensure the running worker has picked up the `Bash(go run github.com/golangci/golangci-lint:*)` rule from `.hivedispatch.yaml` (it's in the file, but the denial suggests this session's policy predates it).

## Summary

Work is complete and committed on `hive/SCRUM-3`; tree is clean, nothing pushed, no PR opened.

- **`AGENTS.md`** (commit `8ee2bf4`) — canonical agent instructions: repo overview, dev setup pointer, an explicit **required protocol** (vet + race tests + lint scoped to touched packages before every commit, module-wide before every push, never commit/push on failure), and the CONTRIBUTING.md rules carried over.
- **`CLAUDE.md`** (same commit) — one-line `@AGENTS.md` import; single source of truth.
- **`docs/decisions.md`** (commit `5d92e05`) — entry recording AGENTS.md-canonical and the alternatives rejected.

**Verification:** `go vet ./...` ✅ and `go test -race ./...` ✅ (all packages ok). `golangci-lint` ❌ **not run** — blocked by permissions as described above. The diff is Markdown-only, so Go code is identical to `main` where lint passes in CI; CI will confirm on the PR.
